capabilities: Append removed text card content to a sibling Markdown note
Archive links to removed note cards, keeping heading and block references
Include text and links of directly connected cards from the last snapshot
Remove an archive entry when a removal is undone
Create archive notes with YAML frontmatter and a canvas link
disambiguation: It does not restore removed cards to the Canvas; it only appends their text or links to a sibling Markdown note.
extras: Only saved changes made while the plugin is enabled are recorded; sync and external edits can also trigger archiving. Groups, web links, attachments, connections and the Canvas itself are ignored, and no hidden comments are inserted.
problem: Deleting a card from a Canvas erases its text or note link with no record, so content written on the Canvas is lost.
summary: Archives text cards and note links removed from a Canvas into a sibling Markdown note, adding the text or links of directly connected cards.
